value.rationale: PASS: For a naturally occurring bielliptic Picard/Prym one-parameter family, the exact scheme-theoretic nonordinary divisor including its doubled multiplicities, complete simple-root count for every split prime, and precise p-rank/a-number strata are substantive geometric arithmetic invariants. This is not a few-prime table, nor a computation of an arbitrary unmotivated parameter slice.

final_claim: For each prime p=6m+1 and smooth parameter a²≠4, the Picard curve Y³Z=X⁴+aX²Z²+Z⁴ has diagonal Hasse–Witt matrix K diag(A(a²−4)^m, Q_m, B(a²−4)^m Q_m), Q_m=[t^(3m)](t²+at+1)^(2m) of degree m and m simple roots in the smooth line. Its nonordinary Cartier divisor is exactly twice that root divisor; rank and a-number are (1,2) at roots and (3,0) otherwise.
limitations: Only p≡1 mod6, a²≠4, marked parameter line; moduli quotient a↦−a not used.
No claims for full Newton polygon, endomorphism rings or p≡5 mod6.
